**Approach.**
- stability: sq ω' c − sq ω c = W·(2V+W) with W=Σcᵢ(ω'−ω)ᵢ, V=Σcᵢωᵢ; `f_leib` plus Cauchy–Schwarz (|Σcᵢaᵢ| ≤ length2 a for unit c) against the jetNorm bounds give 2^ν θ(2M+θ) (Σ C(ν,k)=2^ν); part 1 passes to scalarJet through a sSup-difference lemma (`jetOp_le_add_of`), part 2 via `le_csInf`/`betaFamily_le` and `scalarJet_le_jetMax`, part 3 linear arithmetic.
- scaling_amount: sq(sω)c = t²·sq ω c̃ with c̃ = t⁻¹(s·c) on the sphere, t=length2(s·c)∈[lo,hi] (lower bound); the upper bound applies the same identity to c = τ⁻¹(s⁻¹c'') with τ∈[1/hi,1/lo]. Needs homogeneity `jetMax_const_mul` (via `jetOp_smul`, `Real.sSup_smul_of_nonneg`).
- Note: at ν=0 the jet bound does not need a unit vector (d may be 0); helper hypotheses are `ν = 0 ∨ length2 v = 1`.
